name: Post Process Plotter
author: Acxel Orozco
description: Plot and analyse post-processing output for Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K and VASP: DOS, PDOS, band structures, potentials, and volumetric fields (CHGCAR/LOCPOT/PARCHG/ELFCAR) with planar averages, vacuum levels, work functions, charge sums/differences and Gaussian cube export. Pure Python; no Perl or external executables required.
